title: Talk Structurally, Act Hierarchically: A Collaborative Framework for LLM Multi-Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not use a standalone bias metric, but rather evaluates the overall accuracy and performance of the proposed hierarchical multi-agent framework against sequential baselines on benchmarks like MMLU, WikiQA, and a Camera ad text dataset to demonstrate its ability to mitigate biased outcomes caused by the order in which evaluator feedback is processed.
